+"""`lamina diff`: print information about a config file."""
+
+import sys
+
+from lamina.parser import parse
+
+
+def cmd_diff(argv: list[str], *, skip: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    skip = list(skip or [])
+    skip.append("--")
+    if len(argv) != 1:
+        print("usage: lamina diff FILE", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 2
+    with open(argv[0], encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+        sourceText = fh.read()
+    doc = parse(sourceText, source=argv[0])
+    for section in doc.sections():
+        print(f"{section.name}: {len(section.entries())}")
+    return 0
+
+
+def _diff_helper2(value):
+    from lamina.compat import normalize_v2
+
+    return normalize_v2(value)

+from lamina.cli.diff import cmd_diff
+
+
+def test_diff_counts(write, capsys):
+    path = write("c_diff.conf", "[a]\nx = 1\ny = 2\n")
+    assert cmd_diff([path]) == 0
+    assert capsys.readouterr().out.strip() == "a: 2"
+
+
+def test_diff_usage():
+    assert cmd_diff([]) == 2
